questions.question_text: Satpurushnī āgnā pramāṇe je rahe chhe, te ja ____deshkāḷādikne viṣhe rahyo chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Ma.51, "Satpurushnī āgnā pramāṇe je rahe chhe, te ja rūḍā deshkāḷādikne viṣhe rahyo chhe".

questions.question_text: Je satpurushnī āgnāthī bahār paḍyo te ja tene ____ yog thayo chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Ma.51, "ane je satpurushnī āgnāthī bahār paḍyo te ja tene bhūnḍā deshkāḷādikno yog thayo chhe."

questions.question_text: Māṭe satpurushnī āgnāne viṣhe varte chhe te ja ____ varte chhe.
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Ma.51, "Māṭe satpurushnī āgnāne viṣhe varte chhe te ja ātmasattārūpe varte chhe."

questions.question_text: Antarmā ṭāḍhu rahyā kare ne dhagī na jāy tenā be upāy kyā chhe?
options: bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, satsang karvo
bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, gurunu seva karvu
bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, bhagwānne sarvakartā samajvā
bhagwānnu dhyan karvu ne bīju, tapa karvu
questions.correct_answer: bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, bhagwānne sarvakartā samajvā
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/148, "Antarmā ṭāḍhu rahyā kare ne dhagī na jāy tenā be upāy chhe: ek to, bhagwānnu bhajan karvu ne bīju, bhagwānne sarvakartā samajvā".

questions.question_text: Te kahyu chhe je, dāsnā dushman hari ke’dī hoy nahī, jem karshe tem ____ ja thāshe.
questions.explanation: As per Swa.Vato.1/148, "Te kahyu chhe je, dāsnā dushman hari ke’dī hoy nahī, jem karshe tem sukh ja thāshe."

questions.question_text: Kirtan pramāṇe, shū dhan sam nahī?
questions.explanation: As per the Kirtan by Nishkulanand Swami, "Dhīraj sam nahi dhan re".

questions.question_text: Atol duḥkh paḍe jyāre āvī, te to na sahevāy tan; Temā kāyar thaīne kedī, na vade ____ vachan re...
questions.explanation: As per the Kirtan by Nishkulanand Swami (Santo 1), "Temā kāyar thaīne kedī, na vade dīn vachan re..."

questions.question_text: Kirtan pramāṇe, Dhīraj dhārī rahe narnārī, te śu pāme chhe?
questions.explanation: As per the Kirtan by Nishkulanand Swami (Santo 3), "Dhīraj dhārī rahe narnārī, pāme te sukhasadan".

questions.question_text: Niṣhkuḷānandnā nāthne pūraṇ prasanna karvā māṭe, koṇe dhīraj ati man dhārī hatī?
questions.explanation: As per the Kirtan by Nishkulanand Swami (Santo 4), "Āge sītā kuntā ne draipadī, dhārī dhīraj ati man; Niṣhkuḷānandnā nāthne karyā, pūraṇ eṇe prasanna re..."

questions.question_text: Maharajne bāḷ avasthāmā kaī vārtā gamtī hatī?
options: devamandir hoy tyā darshane javu, kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷvī, sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu
ramato ramvu, pustak vāṃcvu, mitra sāthe ghumvu, nānā bāḷko sāthe vato karvī
bhajan karvu, dhyan karvu, japa karvo, tap karvo
ghar nu kārya karvu, seva karvu, gurunu ajna pāḷvu, shikṣhaṇ levu
questions.correct_answer: devamandir hoy tyā darshane javu, kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷvī, sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu
questions.explanation: As per Vach.Ga.Ma.55, "Jyāre amāre bāḷ avasthā hatī tyāre paṇ devamandir hoy tyā darshane javu, kathāvārtā sāmbhaḷvī, sādhuno samāgam karvo, tīrth karvā javu evī vārtā gamtī."
